title: The Mindaro, A JdV By Hyatt Hotel, Celebrates Grand Opening
summary: New lifestyle hotel brings Pacific Northwest-inspired design, local flavor and a connected stay, dining and events experience to Portland International Airport
body_markdown:
**CHICAGO, IL (November 6, 2026) —** The Mindaro, a JdV by Hyatt hotel, is now open, introducing a vibrant new lifestyle experience to Portland. Inspired by the spirit and natural beauty of the Pacific Northwest, **The Mindaro** features 90 spacious guestrooms, each nearly 500 square feet and thoughtfully designed to balance style, comfort and function.


Designed for travelers and locals alike, The Mindaro offers plenty of ways to settle in, recharge and connect. Guest rooms feature thoughtful touches, including fine linens and locally sourced coffee and tea, bringing a sense of Pacific Northwest character to every stay. A 24-hour fitness center, room service and complimentary Wi-Fi add comfort and convenience throughout the guest experience.


Located just minutes from Portland International Airport (PDX), The Mindaro combines the personality of an independent boutique hotel with the advantages of **The Mindaro Campus** , a connected hospitality destination that also includes **Hyatt House Portland Airport** , **The Hollow Café + Bar** , **Jawfish Restaurant** , and **The Mindaro Event Center** . Together, the hotels, restaurant and event center offer travelers, locals and meeting planners one convenient place to stay, dine, meet and celebrate.


“The Mindaro represents what we envisioned for this property from the beginning, a distinctive hotel that feels connected to Portland and gives people more reasons to stay, gather and experience the destination,” said Rick Takach, chairman and chief executive officer, Vesta Hospitality. “Together with Hyatt House, Jawfish and The Mindaro Event Center, we’ve created a hospitality campus that brings together lodging, dining and events in one connected experience. We’re proud to bring that vision to life.”


**DESIGNED FOR THE STAY**


The Mindaro combines independent character with practical amenities and services designed to make every stay comfortable and convenient.


**THE MINDARO GUEST AMENITIES**


- **In-room Coffee and Tea:** Locally roasted, sustainably sourced single-serve coffee from Caravan Coffee, and a selection of teas from Smith Teamaker
- **Plush Robes:** Cozy comforts designed for relaxing and unwinding
- **Complimentary Wi-Fi:** Available throughout the hotel and guestrooms
- **24-Hour Fitness Center:** An outdoor-inspired space designed to help guests maintain their wellness routines while traveling
- **Room service:** Convenient in-room dining
- **Guest services:** Guest laundry and complimentary grocery shopping services
- **H Market:** Open 24 hours a day to meet guests' everyday needs with snacks, sundries, freshly prepared salads and sandwiches
- **Pet-friendly stays:** Dogs are welcome.[Visit Policies](https://www.hyatt.com/jdv-by-hyatt/en-US/pdxjs-the-mindaro/policies) to learn more and for fees.
- **Complimentary airport transportation:** 24-hour shuttle service to and from Portland International Airport
- **Electric vehicle charging:** Convenient EV charging stations available onsite


**THE MINDARO CAMPUS**


The experience extends beyond the hotel through The Mindaro Campus, bringing together accommodations, dining and flexible meeting and event spaces in one connected destination. The campus includes:


- [Hyatt House Portland Airport](https://www.hyatt.com/hyatt-house/en-US/pdxxa-hyatt-house-portland-airport) **:** 112 guestrooms, including 73 apartment-style Kitchen Suites featuring fully equipped kitchens, comfortable living areas, spacious bedrooms and stylish bathrooms.
- [Jawfish Restaurant](https://www.jawfishpdx.com/) **:** Inventive cooking, elevated comfort favorites and a robust bar program served with Pacific Northwest energy. Open daily from 11 a.m. to 11 p.m., Jawfish also provides onsite catering for meetings and events across the campus.
- **The Hollow Café + Bar** : Located in the hotel's lobby, The Hollow **Café + Bar** offers crafted coffee beverages featuring Stumptown Coffee alongside simple yet satisfying breakfast offerings in the morning. In the afternoon and evening, the café will transition into a bar serving regional wines, craft beers and small plates in a relaxed and inviting setting.
- [Le Petit Chef](https://www.jawfishpdx.com/le-petit-chef) : A first for Oregon, Le Petit Chef is an immersive culinary adventure that combines a three-dimensional animated dinner show with thoughtfully curated prix fixe menus, creating an engaging and memorable dining experience. Le Petit Chef is an experience offered at Jawfish Restaurant. Reservations are required and shows take place Thursday – Sunday.
- [The Mindaro Event Center:](https://www.hyatt.com/jdv-by-hyatt/en-US/pdxjs-the-mindaro/meetings) More than 8,000 square feet of flexible meeting and event space, including a 5,300-square-foot ballroom, the more than 2,000-square-foot divisible Willamette Room and two dedicated boardrooms. The venue accommodates everything from executive meetings and corporate trainings to conferences, galas and social celebrations.


**A DISTINCTLY PACIFIC NORTHWEST EXPERIENCE**


The Mindaro brings the spirit of the Pacific Northwest to life through expressive design, natural materials and a sense of discovery. Inspired by the region’s forests and landscapes, this unexpected urban retreat pairs warm hospitality with a distinctly local point of view.


“The Mindaro has a personality all its own, and that’s what I’m most excited for guests to discover,” said Phillip Wilson, general manager. “There’s a sense of the Pacific Northwest throughout the experience, from the design and local touches to the food, coffee and spaces where people can connect. Whether guests are here for a quick trip, a meeting or a weekend exploring the city, we want them to feel genuinely welcomed and leave having experienced something memorable and distinctly Portland.”


*The term “Hyatt” is used in this release for convenience to refer to Hyatt Hotels Corporation and/or one or more of its affiliates.*


**About JDV by Hyatt**


The JdV by Hyatt brand offers a collection of independent hotels that exhibit personality and joy. True to its namesake, *joie de vivre* , the properties are vibrant reflections of their surroundings, inviting guests to embrace discovery in their travels. Enjoy World of Hyatt benefits with eligible stays at JdV by Hyatt hotels – discover more[here.](https://www.hyatt.com/jdv-by-hyatt/en-US)


**About the Mindaro**


[The Mindaro](https://www.hyatt.com/jdv-by-hyatt/en-US/pdxjs-the-mindaro) is a 90-room JdV by Hyatt hotel located near Portland International Airport in Portland, Oregon. Inspired by the natural beauty and creative spirit of the Pacific Northwest, the vibrant lifestyle hotel offers spacious guestrooms, expressive design, locally inspired amenities and Hollow Café + Bar. The hotel is part of The Mindaro Campus, a connected hospitality destination that also includes Hyatt House Portland Airport, Jawfish Restaurant and The Mindaro Event Center, creating a flexible destination for travelers, locals and meeting planners to stay, dine, meet and celebrate.
